item.title: Trump says all mines cleared from Strait of Hormuz
item.description: President Trump announced that the U.S. Navy has removed all mines from the main shipping lane in the Strait of Hormuz, a key route for global oil shipments.

item.title: Court denies Ghislaine Maxwell's appeal of conviction
item.description: A federal judge has rejected Ghislaine Maxwell's attempt to overturn her conviction, dismissing arguments that relied on newly released Epstein-related documents.

item.title: AI increases vulnerability of critical infrastructure
item.description: Long-standing concerns about digital weaknesses in essential utilities are now compounded by AI, which makes these vulnerabilities easier to exploit.
